import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

            col_out=c1+1 if j<cmid else c0-1
            newg[i][j]=bg
            newg[row_out][col_out]=v

import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); di=G['Demo pair 1 input']; do=G['Demo pair 1 output']
di2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; do2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
ti=G['Test input']
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    newg=[r[:] for r in g]
    rmid=(r0+r1)/2; cmid=(c0+c1)/2
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==bg: continue
            row_out=r1+1 if i<=rmid else r0-1
            col_out=c1+1 if j<cmid else c0-1
            newg[i][j]=bg
            newg[row_out][col_out]=v
    return newg
print('demo1', json.dumps(f(di))==json.dumps(do))
print('demo2', json.dumps(f(di2))==json.dumps(do2))
out=f(ti)
for r_ in out: print(' '.join(map(str,r_)))
print(json.dumps(out))
